name: Harikrishnan N
title: Sr Business Analyst, Trust & Safety Analytics
summary: Analyst with five years in trust and safety, risk detection and enforcement quality for a high-volume streaming catalog. I turn review and audit data into decisions: data analysis and risk-based sampling in SQL on Amazon Redshift, accuracy reporting on automated rating models, QuickSight dashboards and business reviews for leadership, and Python tooling on AWS that keeps it running. Systems I built are used daily by 200+ people across global review teams, with measured gains in detection, hours saved and data reliability.

experience.role: Sr Business Analyst, Trust & Safety Analytics

categories.name: Risk detection and enforcement quality
bullets: Redesigned quality sampling and enforcement validation logic across 11 review workflows, increasing detection of critical defects by 30% and reducing audit noise.
Built a daily ETL feedback loop that re-tunes risk signals from audit outcomes, so sampling follows the latest defect pattern with minimal manual intervention.
Ran root-cause analyses on false-positive and false-negative enforcement signals, improving sampling accuracy and decision reliability.
Supported regulatory and compliance data requests across 3 global teams with accurate, traceable evidence under strict governance.

categories.name: Audit platforms and automation
bullets: Designed and built an end-to-end audit orchestration platform (Python, Flask, DynamoDB, Redshift, CloudWatch): title ingestion, allocation, prioritisation, blind audit and comparison engine, automatic reassignment and alerts. Used by 200+ people, saves about 18 analyst-hours a day, manual touchpoints cut from 30+ to 3.

Built a browser-automation agent that replaced manual storefront compliance walkthroughs: navigates the storefront, simulates playback, captures on-screen maturity ratings and content descriptors via cloud OCR, and cross-checks them against audit records to produce pass/fail outcomes and flag mismatches.
Built an accuracy pipeline comparing automated rating decisions against human review in shadow mode, with defect classification, anomaly categories and daily dashboards for program owners.
Built a time and motion engine with an in-app step builder, step-level timing, handle-time rollups and bottleneck detection, used to set weekly targets and pick automation candidates.

categories.name: Analytics and decision support
bullets: Built centralised, self-serve quality dashboards used by 20+ managers, reducing reporting overhead and speeding up risk-based decisions.
Built a review demand forecast for next-year capacity planning from 36 months of catalog history, with backtested models and a leadership dashboard.
Developed Python monitoring tools used by 300+ employees for real-time visibility into data health and pipeline failures, saving about 2 analyst-hours daily.
Prototyped LLM-based tooling that drafts weekly business review insights directly from source tables.
Resolved 100+ ad-hoc data requests from cross-functional stakeholders; translated SQL analyses into executive-ready narratives.
Content analysis and classification at 98% productivity with 100% quality.
Handled sensitive data under strict governance protocols.
Collaborated with 40+ team members on data collection, validation and weekly reporting.
Produced daily MIS reports for senior leadership from operational, inventory and sales data.
Managed SAP-based operations: vendor liabilities, inventory reconciliation, stock transfer analysis.
Prepared statutory TDS and TCS returns, keeping the unit audit-ready.
